title: 第34章 泼猴，快出来
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 梁会长眼睛一亮，兴致勃勃地说起来：“国风展会面向全球，来的都是重量级嘉宾。”“我们礼仪人员的、主持人的、还有主办方特邀嘉宾，穿着的服装都要体现我们龙国特色。”“我们收了一堆稿子，到现在没挑到满意的。”他看向温栩栩，眼里带着几分期待：“栩栩，你要不要试试？给我们投个稿？”温栩栩愣了一下，随即眼睛亮了。“梁会长，您看看这个——”她打开手机，点开一个文件夹，递给梁会长。“这是我的毕业设计作品，也是国风方向的。”梁会长接过来，一张一张划过去。第一张，是一件改良宋制长裙，颜色取自宋代青瓷的“天青釉”，淡雅温润，裙摆绣着缠枝莲纹。保留了宋裙的飘逸感，但剪裁更贴合现代人身形，走路抬手都自在，不像传统服装那样层层叠叠。第二张，是一件明制交领袄裙，用了明代斗彩瓷器的红蓝配色，领口和袖口绣着缠枝花纹，端庄里透着几分灵动。裙子做了收腰设计，衣摆也短了些，穿上能跑能跳，不会一弯腰就踩到裙角。第三张、第四张、第五张……每一件都各有特色。梁会长越看眼睛越亮，最后忍不住拍了下大腿：“好！这个好！”他抬头看向温栩栩，眼神里全是欣赏：“不愧是你啊，这眼光，这审美，绝了！”温栩栩被夸得有点不好意思，抿着嘴笑。梁会长已经掏出手机，当场拨了个电话：“喂，芳姐，我给你发个东西，你看看。对，就是咱们展会的服装设计——有个小姑娘的稿子，我觉得特别对味。”挂断电话，他冲温栩栩眨眨眼：“我把你的稿子发给负责服装的总设计师了。等消息吧。”林家父女坐在角落里，尴尬得像两尊摆设。走也不是，留也不是。林念薇终于忍不住，凑到林深云耳边小声嘀咕：“爸，就她那个设计水平？美院一抓一大把。梁会长也就是面子上过意不去，帮忙推荐一下罢了。”林深云没说话，但脸色明显缓了缓。说得也对。艺术是需要烧钱培养的，温栩栩一个贫困生，她那个哥哥供她读书都费劲，艺术境界能高到哪里去？就在这时，梁会长的手机响了。他接起来，刚“喂”了一声，对面就传来一个激动到破音的女声：“老梁！那几套衣服我全要了！那个小姑娘在哪儿？我现在就要见她！！”梁会长把手机拿远了一点，等那边喊完了，才慢悠悠地回：“人就在我旁边。”梁会长和服装负责人那边聊了许久，随后他挂断电话，看向温栩栩，眼里带着笑意：“丫头，你这几套毕业设计，人家全看上了。”温栩栩还没来得及高兴，梁会长又补了一句：“对了，你毕业作品展的场地找好没有？”温栩栩一愣。梁会长笑得眼睛都眯起来：“国风展会这边，给你划块场地，专门做你的毕业作品展——够不够排面？”温栩栩张了张嘴，半天没说出话。……傻眼了！服装设计专业的毕业作品展，一般都是在学校租的场地里统一办。有钱有资源的同学会自已找地方，但费钱费力，还得自已拉人脉。而她呢？直接能在全球级别的国风展会上开个人毕业展？这个展会她刚听梁会长提过。面向全球市场、国家大力扶持、官媒和海外媒体都盯着的那种。能在这种地方露个脸，就够吹一辈子了。而她直接在这儿开个人展？温栩栩愣了三秒，才找回自已的声音：“梁会长，您说的是……让我去国风展会做毕业展？”梁会长笑了：“怎么，嫌不够大？”“不是不是！”温栩栩赶紧摆手，脑袋摇得像拨浪鼓，“我是觉得……这馅饼也太大了吧？”梁会长笑着摆了摆手：“小丫头，别高兴太早，不过我这可不是画饼。”他指了指温栩栩的设计手稿：“我们国风展会今年确实想在服装板块加一个年轻设计师的独立展位，但一直没找到合适的人选。”“手稿看了不少，要么太老气，要么太浮夸，没几个能用的。”梁会长看向温栩栩，眼神里带着几分认真：“你的手稿和效果图有灵气，底子在。但如果成品做出来达不到标准，我也不能硬塞进去。”温栩栩点点头，认真听着。梁会长笑了：“所以这不是馅饼，是机会。只要你的成品能让大家满意，那个展位就是你的。”“怎么样，敢不敢接？”温栩栩想都没想，直接点头：“接！反正是个机会，先试试再说！”她现在手里有钱，心里有底，还有神仙撑腰。怕什么？“再说了，”温栩栩弯了弯眼睛，“万一真成了呢？”林家父女坐在角落里，脸都快气白了。这一趟，本来是来要展位的，结果展位没要到，古籍还被退了回来。而温栩栩呢？捡个垃圾赚了210万，还顺手捞走了一个国风展会的展位。这运气真是……林深云深吸一口气，站起身，匆匆告辞。林念薇跟在他身后，脸色比锅底还黑。*温栩栩刚走出司家大门，就被两个人拦住了。林念薇抱着手臂，脸上的笑比哭还难看：“温栩栩，你别高兴太早。国风展会那种地方，是你说上就能上的？”温栩栩眨了眨眼，从兜里掏出那张支票，在她面前晃了晃：“总比某些人——连机会都没有的，要好那么一点点吧？”林念薇的脸，彻底绿了。温栩栩把支票收回包里，冲她挥了挥手，头也不回地走了。去医院看望哥哥回来已经是晚上了。回到青林湾别墅，推开门的瞬间，温栩栩站在玄关愣了两秒。太大了。落地窗外是安静的夜色，客厅空荡荡的，旋转楼梯延伸到二楼，一点声音都没有。她换了鞋，上楼，洗了个澡。温热的水流冲下来的时候还没觉得什么，等她擦着头发走出浴室——卧室还是那么安静。窗帘没拉严，外面的路灯透进来一点点光，把墙角照得忽明忽暗。空调外机嗡嗡响了一下，又停了，剩下满屋的寂静压下来。温栩栩坐在床边，抱着枕头，忽然有点想念医院里哥哥那张病床旁边的陪护椅。掏出手机，点开神仙群。温栩栩：【各位神仙大人，我哥还没出院，我一个人住别墅……好空啊，好害怕啊呜呜呜。】很快，财神爷冒泡了：财神爷：【@齐天大圣 泼猴！平时游手好闲到处溜达偷桃子吃，这会儿死哪儿去了？】财神爷：【你鬼点子最多了，快出来支个招，给咱们群团宠壮壮胆！】
content_en: President Liang's eyes lit up and he spoke enthusiastically: "The National Style Exhibition is open to the world, and all the heavyweight guests are here." "The costumes worn by our etiquette staff, hosts, and special guests from the organizer must reflect the characteristics of our Dragon Kingdom." "We have received a bunch of manuscripts, but we haven't found anything satisfactory so far." He looked at Wen Xuxu with some expectation in his eyes: "Xuxu, do you want to give it a try? Submit a manuscript for us?" Wen Xuxu was stunned for a moment, and then his eyes lit up."President Liang, look at this -" She opened her phone, clicked on a folder, and handed it to President Liang."This is my graduation project, and it is also in the direction of Chinese style." President Liang took it and crossed it one by one.The first picture is an improved long skirt made in the Song Dynasty. The color is taken from the "celestial glaze" of celadon from the Song Dynasty. It is elegant and gentle, and the skirt is embroidered with a lotus pattern.It retains the elegant feeling of the Song skirt, but the cut is more suitable for the modern body shape. You can walk and raise your hands freely without the layers of traditional clothing.The second picture is of a cross-collar coat skirt made in the Ming Dynasty. It uses the red and blue colors of Ming Dynasty Doucai porcelain. The collar and cuffs are embroidered with tangled branches, which is dignified and a bit smart.The skirt has a waist-cinching design and the hem is also shorter. It allows you to run and jump in it without stepping on the corners of the skirt when you bend over.The third one, the fourth one, the fifth one...each one has its own characteristics.President Liang's eyes became brighter and brighter as he looked at it, and finally he couldn't help but pat his thigh: "Okay! This is good!" He looked up at Wen Xuxu, his eyes full of admiration: "As expected of you, this vision and aesthetics are amazing!" Wen Xuxu was a little embarrassed by the praise, and she pursed her lips and smiled.President Liang had already taken out his mobile phone and made a call on the spot: "Hey, Sister Fang, I'll send you something for you to take a look at. Yes, it's the costume design for our exhibition - there's a little girl's manuscript, which I find particularly interesting." After hanging up the phone, he winked at Wen Xuxu: "I sent your manuscript to the chief designer in charge of clothing. Just wait for the news." The Lin family and their daughter were sitting in the corner, as embarrassed as two statues.Neither leaving nor staying.Lin Nianwei finally couldn't help it, and whispered in Lin Shenyun's ear: "Dad, is it her level of design? The Academy of Fine Arts caught a lot of them. President Liang just wanted to feel sorry for himself, so he just gave me a recommendation." Lin Shenyun didn't say anything, but his expression softened obviously.That's right.Art requires spending money to cultivate. Wen Xuxu is a poor student, and her brother has trouble supporting her to study. How high can her artistic level be?At this moment, President Liang’s cell phone rang.He picked it up and just said "Hey" when an excited female voice came from the opposite side: "Old Liang! I want all those sets of clothes! Where is that little girl? I want to see her now!!" President Liang took the phone a little further away, and after the other person finished shouting, he replied slowly: "He is right next to me." President LiangAfter chatting with the person in charge of costumes for a long time, he hung up the phone and looked at Wen Xuxu with a smile in his eyes: "Girl, these graduation designs of yours are all popular." Before Wen Xuxu could be happy, President Liang added: "By the way, have you found a venue for your graduation work exhibition?" Wen Xuxu was stunned.President Liang smiled so hard that his eyes narrowed: "Here at the National Style Exhibition, we will set aside a space for you to hold your graduation exhibition - is it enough?" Wen Xuxu opened his mouth, but said nothing for a long time....I was dumbfounded!Graduation exhibitions of fashion design majors are usually held in a venue rented by the school.Students with money and resources will find a place on their own, but it takes a lot of money and effort, and they have to make connections on their own.And what about her?Can you directly hold a personal graduation exhibition at a global-level national style exhibition?She had just heard President Liang mention this exhibition.The kind that faces the global market, is strongly supported by the state, and is watched closely by official and overseas media.Being able to show your face in a place like this is enough to boast about for a lifetime.And she opens a solo exhibition directly here?Wen Xuxu was stunned for three seconds before she found her voice: "President Liang, what you are saying is... that you want me to go to the National Style Exhibition for my graduation exhibition?" President Liang smiled: "Why, you think it's not big enough?" "No, no!" Wen Xuxu quickly waved her hand., head shaking like a rattle, "I think... this pie is too big, right?" President Liang smiled and waved his hand: "Little girl, don't be too happy, but I am not painting a pie." He pointed to Wen Xuxu's design manuscript:"We really want to add an independent booth for young designers to the clothing section of the Chinese Style Exhibition this year, but we have not found a suitable candidate." "I have read a lot of manuscripts, but they are either too old-fashioned or too exaggerated, and few of them are usable." President Liang looked at Wen Xuxu with a serious look in his eyes: "Your manuscripts and renderings have aura, and the foundation is there. But if the finished product does not meet the standards, I can't force it in." Wen Xuxu nodded and listened carefully.President Liang smiled: "So this is not a pie, but an opportunity. As long as your finished product satisfies everyone, that booth will be yours." "How about it, do you dare to accept it?" Wen Xuxu nodded directly without even thinking about it: "Accept it! Anyway, it's an opportunity, let's try it first!" She now has money in her hands, confidence in her heart, and the support of gods.What are you afraid of?"Besides," Wen Xuxu rolled his eyes, "What if it really happens?" The Lin family's father and daughter were sitting in the corner, their faces almost turning pale with anger.On this trip, I originally came to ask for a booth, but the booth was not available and the ancient books were returned.And what about Wen Xuxu?I made 2.1 million yuan by picking up rubbish, and I also got a booth at a Chinese style exhibition.This is such luck... Lin Shenyun took a deep breath, stood up, and said goodbye in a hurry.Lin Nianwei followed him, her face darker than the bottom of the pot.*As soon as Wen Xuxu walked out of the Si family gate, he was stopped by two people.Lin Nianwei crossed her arms, and the smile on her face was uglier than crying: "Wen Xuxu, don't be too happy. Can you get into a place like the National Style Exhibition just by asking?" Wen Xuxu blinked, took out the check from his pocket, and waved it in front of her: "It's a little better than some people who don't even have a chance, right?" Lin Nianwei's face turned completely green.Wen Xuxu put the check back in his bag, waved to her, and left without looking back.It was already evening when I came back from visiting my brother in the hospital.Returning to Qinglin Bay Villa, the moment she opened the door, Wen Xuxu stood in the entrance hall and was stunned for two seconds.Too big.It was a quiet night outside the floor-to-ceiling windows. The living room was empty. The spiral staircase extended to the second floor, and there was no sound at all.She changed her shoes, went upstairs, and took a shower.She didn't feel anything when the warm water rushed down. When she wiped her hair and walked out of the bathroom - the bedroom was still so quiet.The curtains were not tightly drawn, and a little light came in from the street lamp outside, illuminating the corner of the wall.The air conditioner buzzed for a moment, then stopped, leaving the room filled with silence.Wen Xuxu sat on the edge of the bed, hugging the pillow, and suddenly missed the accompanying chair next to her brother's bed in the hospital.Take out your phone and click on the group of gods.Wen Xuxu: [Dear gods and lords, my brother has not been discharged from the hospital yet, and I live alone in the villa... I feel so empty, so scared, oh wow.】Soon, the God of Wealth bubbled up: God of Wealth: [@ Monkey King Monkey!I usually wander around and steal peaches to eat, but where did I die now?】God of Wealth: 【You have the most clever ideas. Come out and make a move to embolden us!】
